scope: Bounded data-only source review; no services, original puzzle code, paid experiments or redesigned evaluators executed.

records.title: 1999/puzzles/1Gumshoe/Prague/prague.html
records.review: Initial reuse email, later floppy-disk release and conditional plaintext must not be collapsed into one initial packet.
records.next_requirement: Recover authoritative team/phase release state; local reusefind alone is not the whole event.

records.title: 1999/puzzles/2Investigator/CharlotteAmalie/charlotteamalie.html
records.review: A team was assigned one of five coloured actor scripts, not the union of all scripts.
records.next_requirement: Establish the assigned script and delivery context; do not choose or aggregate silently.

records.title: 2000/endgame.html
records.review: The endgame depends on earlier meta answers and digit lookup; those antecedent inputs are not a self-contained packet.
records.next_requirement: Define the original prerequisite packet without exposing solved prerequisites prematurely.

records.title: 2001/phase1/12/index.html
records.review: The linked historical Marvel image was not recovered; direct access failed and the checked archive availability response was empty.
records.next_requirement: Recover that exact historical image; a modern character picture is not a verified replacement.

records.title: 2001/phase4/06/index.html
records.review: Both checked official/mirror EXE downloads timed out. A timeout is not a 404 or proof of permanent loss.
records.next_requirement: Recover the original executable and separately authorize an isolated compatibility review; nothing was executed.

records.title: 2009/puzzles/virtual-sectors.html
records.review: The archived page contains an all-unlocked state and disabled Spin Control; original starting state is not established.
records.next_requirement: Recover the release/unlock state before staging the fourteen sectors as initial inputs.

records.title: 2010/puzzles/2010/training_exercise/
records.review: Exact 2010 MBTA and WMATA map editions matter to the puzzle. The Harvard candidate returned HTML 403; the checked WMATA archive lookup had no snapshot.
records.next_requirement: Recover matching historical maps; do not substitute present-day routes, station markers or accessibility labels.

records.title: 2011/puzzles/world1/pattern_recognition/
records.review: Seven local images include eighteen video links. oEmbed succeeded for fourteen, returned 403 for two and 404 for two; this is metadata, not playback verification.
records.next_requirement: Recover or verify the actual linked historical videos and their exact image-map positions; do not replace them with titles.

records.title: 2012/puzzles/a_circus_line/
records.review: The official round source was recovered, but its dynamic release, guesses and points still require a defined starting state.
records.next_requirement: Specify the isolated round controller and original starting inputs.

records.title: 2013/coinheist.com/indiana/analogy_farm/index.html
records.review: The original Glitch host returns 410. Archived author code uses Python 2, Bottle and a mutable SQLite-backed game.
records.next_requirement: A separately scoped isolated runtime adaptation is needed; do not import or run the source against original services.

records.title: 2013/coinheist.com/indiana/snow_day/index.html
records.review: The original Snow Day host redirects to a domain-sale page; the author page reports that the puzzle no longer works and original assets are being sought.
records.next_requirement: Recover original author assets; no replacement game or answer is invented.

records.title: 2013/coinheist.com/rubik/our_fates_are_interlocked/index.html
records.review: The original script posts to new-session and move-lever endpoints and receives hidden light/lever state. It was read, not executed.
records.next_requirement: Recover server rules and an isolated initial-state contract; no live session requests were made.

records.title: 2013/coinheist.com/rubik/the_maze/index.html
records.review: Original JavaScript implements a four-dimensional maze with walls revealed on collision. A static all-wall map changes available information.
records.next_requirement: A separately scoped interaction adapter is needed; do not publish hidden walls as starting clues.

records.title: 2015/puzzle/goldfish_memory
records.review: Goldfish Memory uses a sequenced POST session and a flip-card endpoint; its 2,602-byte session helper was fully read.
records.next_requirement: Recover isolated card/session rules; no flips, sessions or reset calls were sent to the original service.

records.title: 2016/puzzle/believe
records.review: The archived Believe script contains the formerly server-hidden word bank and hangman state.
records.next_requirement: An isolated stateful adapter must keep the hidden bank out of initial assets; do not expose all words as a static puzzle.

Puzzles Sorta Insightful Reviews Projects Puzzles Archive Research About In a world where everyone has opinions, one man...also has opinions Puzzles Last updated May 25, 2026. One of my main hobbies is puzzlehunts. They’re a little hard to describe,
but generally, a puzzlehunt puzzle is some data that usually
doesn’t come with direct instructions. Figuring out what to do is part of the
puzzle, and it will usually be obvious when you are doing the right thing.
Puzzles come in all sorts of forms, but will always result in an answer, which is
usually an English word or phrase. See this post for a more detailed introduction. I’ve been solving puzzlehunts since 2010, and normally try to fly in for MIT Mystery Hunt, which is the biggest puzzlehunt of the year.
Here are some Mystery Hunt related things I’ve written: Mystery Hunt Bingo Write-ups for past Mystery Hunts: 2016 2017 2018 2019 2020 2021 2022 2023 2024 2025 2026 I’ve also written some puzzles.
My more recent puzzles are better than my old ones, but I’m including everything for
completeness. 2026 Enigmarch 2026 Enigmarch is a yearly puzzle challenge to write one puzzle every day of March based on a single word prompt.
